candidate: failure-only action-authority asymmetry under teacher-forced future supervision
source_commit: local cloned FACT source; hashes below
facts: Training layout is [state | ref | pred_action | gt_action | future_state | value | future_image].
Attention mask makes pred_action A a sink: A sees P+A, while gt_action G, future_state/value SV, and future_image I cannot see A.
Training passes noisy predicted action A and clean ground-truth action G; future_state/value/image heads are conditioned on G, not A.
The action loss is masked to zero on failure_episode, while future_state and value losses remain active; failure_active adds value penalty.
Inference Stage 1 denoises action using state/ref/text only; Stage 2 sets gt_action_clean equal to the Stage-1 predicted action and predicts future/value from that generated action.
Thus training never scores future/value under the action actually generated by the action head; failure samples additionally provide no action imitation gradient.
candidate_claim: An attacker who can induce or supply valid failure-labelled trajectories can exploit the native teacher-forcing/action-quarantine path: the model can retain normal future/value losses and apparently plausible imagined outcomes under ground-truth actions while the deployed action head drifts; at inference the drift becomes the Stage-2 condition, creating a hidden action-to-outcome integrity gap and closed-loop failures.
distinction_requirements: Do not count generic multi-task gradient interference.
Do not count ordinary teacher-forcing exposure bias unless the native action sink plus failure-only action masking creates a world-action-model-specific security primitive.
Require an executable threat path and a mechanism that persists under clean success training and no parameter tampering.
Compare against FACT itself and prior action-conditioned world models.
audit_questions: Is this genuinely novel and broad enough for a major security/ML venue?
